esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; U2.OUT → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ resistor from OUT to 3V3, as the datasheet's circuit requires. Added a separate 12 V supply for VCC (it needs 6–36 V and up to 13 mA, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the ljc18a3.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports an object when the sensor is triggered: passes
